run_when: A finance or bookkeeping job post mentions catch-up or cleanup work, or search results are available.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company's books are behind or messy: months not closed, a bookkeeping backlog, or past periods that need to be cleaned up or rebuilt.
prompt.definition: The strongest services trigger: 69% of companies that wanted help on sales calls had books behind or messy.
yes_when: A job post asks for catch-up or cleanup bookkeeping, a backlog of reconciliations, or rebuilding past periods
The company or a founder says publicly that their books are behind or a mess
no_when: Not applicable; use unknown when nothing is found
unknown_when: An open finance role with no sign of a backlog
watch_out_for: 'Clean up data' or 'technical backlog' in an engineering post is not about the books
Job sites mix employers with similar names: a listing counts only if its employer is this company (same company page, domain or location)

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" bookkeeper OR accountant "catch-up" OR cleanup OR backlog site:builtin.com OR site:ziprecruiter.com OR site:linkedin.com/jobs OR site:ycombinator.com OR site:wellfound.com
site:linkedin.com/posts ("{company}" OR "{founders}") "behind on" books OR bookkeeping
good_sources: job sites (Built In, ZipRecruiter, LinkedIn Jobs, YC Work at a Startup, Wellfound)
